meta.description: Standalone CLAP-style placement-only config for the current mgpusim-chiplet simulator, using 4 chiplets x 8 SA/chiplet x 4 CU/SA.
workflow: 1) baseline RR run with 4-chiplet simulator flags to generate profile.json
2) standalone CLAP planner consumes the 4-chiplet profile.json and emits placement-only explicit plan
3) final run uses RR scheduling with the explicit CLAP-style page placement
meta.banks_note: banks_per_chiplet is set to 8 so total memory banks remain 32, matching the previous 8 chiplets x 4 banks/chiplet setup.
meta.capacity_note: chiplet_cap_pages is doubled from 400 to 800 to preserve approximate total normal placement capacity after reducing chiplets from 8 to 4. overflow_pages is doubled from 64 to 128 for the same reason.
meta.note: This config belongs to the independent standalone CLAP branch. The CLAP planner clamps grouped contiguous decisions by max_contiguous_group_pages, which is set to banks_per_chiplet=8 here.
meta.selection_note: Use per-buffer page-group selection by default to better match CLAP's per-data-structure suitable page-size selection.
